method: Closed welcome, product explanation, and setup summary: actual filled four-region Dallas desktop treemap or total-scaled mobile bar fills vs all visible text ranges. Headings, chart labels, buttons and instructions count as text; overlapping text is subtracted from graphic fill, so it is not double-counted. Transparent mobile card tracks, whitespace/card backgrounds and decorative outlines never count. Global masthead, following tickers/finder/report, and unopened disclosure content are outside this landing observation.
